1.t: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise

2.t: Indeed, We have sent down the Book to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth, so worship Allah ˹alone˺, being sincerely devoted to Him
2.tr: Innaaa anzalnaaa ilaikal Kitaaba bilhaqqi fa'budil laaha mukhlisal lahud deen

3.t: Indeed, sincere devotion is due ˹only˺ to Allah. As for those who take other lords besides Him, ˹saying,˺ “We worship them only so they may bring us closer to Allah,” surely Allah will judge between all regarding what they differed about. Allah certainly does not guide whoever persists in lying and disbelief
3.tr: Alaa lillaahid deenul khaalis; wallazeenat takhazoo min dooniheee awliyaaa'a maa na'buduhum illaa liyuqar-riboonaaa ilal laahi zulfaa; innal laaha yahkumu baina-hum fee maa hum feehi yakhtalifoon; innal laaha laa yahdee man huwa kaazibun kaffaar

4.t: Had it been Allah’s Will to have offspring, He could have chosen whatever He willed of His creation. Glory be to Him! He is Allah—the One, the Supreme
4.tr: Law araadal laahu aien yattakhiza waladal lastafaa mimmaa yakhluqu maa yashaaa'; Subhaanahoo Huwal laahul Waahidul Qahhaar

5.t: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. He wraps the night around the day, and wraps the day around the night. And He has subjected the sun and the moon, each orbiting for an appointed term. He is truly the Almighty, Most Forgiving
5.tr: Khalaqas samaawaati wal-arda bilhaqq; yukawwirul laila 'alan nahaari Wa-yukawwirun nahaara 'alaal laili Wa-sakhkharash shamsa walqamara kulluny yajree li-ajalim musammaa; alaa Huwal 'Azeezul Ghaffaar

6.t: He created you ˹all˺ from a single soul, then from it He made its mate. And He produced for you four pairs of cattle. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers ˹in stages˺, one development after another, in three layers of darkness. That is Allah—your Lord! All authority belongs to Him. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. How can you then be turned away
6.tr: Khalaqakum min nafsinw waahidatin summa ja'ala minhaa zawjahaa Wa-anzala lakum minal an'aami samaani-yata azwaaj; yakhlu-qukum fee butooni ummahaatikum khalqam mim ba'di khalqin fee zulumaatin salaas; zaalikumul laahu Rabbukum lahul mulk; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa fa-annaa tusrafoon

7.t: If you disbelieve, then ˹know that˺ Allah is truly not in need of you, nor does He approve of disbelief from His servants. But if you become grateful ˹through faith˺, He will appreciate that from you. No soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you of what you used to do. He certainly knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart
7.tr: In takfuroo fa-innal laaha ghaniyyun 'ankum; Wa-laa yardaa li'ibaadihil kufra Wa-in tashkuroo yardahu lakum; Wa-laa taziru waaziratunw wizra ukhraa; summa ilaa Rabikum marji'ukum fa-yunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon; innahoo 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor

8.t: When one is touched with hardship, they cry out to their Lord, turning to Him ˹alone˺. But as soon as He showers them with blessings from Him, they ˹totally˺ forget the One they had cried to earlier, and set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy your disbelief for a little while! You will certainly be one of the inmates of the Fire.”
8.tr: Wa-izaa massal insaana durrun da'aa Rabbahoo muneeban ilaihi summa izaa khawwalahoo ni'matam minhu nasiya maa kaana yad'ooo ilaihi min qablu Wa-ja'ala lillaahi andaadal liyudilla 'an sabeelih; qul tamatta' bikufrika qaleelan innaka min Ashaabin Naar;

9.t: ˹Are they better˺ or those who worship ˹their Lord˺ devoutly in the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of their Lord? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” None will be mindful ˹of this˺ except people of reason
9.tr: Amman huwa qaanitun aanaaa'al laili saajidanw Wa-qaaa'imai yahzarul Aakhirata Wa-yarjoo rahmata Rabbih; qul hal yastawil lazeena ya'lamoona wallazeena laa ya'lamoon; innamaa yatazakkaru ulul albaab

10.t: Say ˹O Prophet, that Allah says˺, “O My servants who believe! Be mindful of your Lord. Those who do good in this world will have a good reward. And Allah’s earth is spacious. Only those who endure patiently will be given their reward without limit.”
10.tr: Qul yaa-'ibaadil lazeena aamanut taqoo Rabbakum; lillazeena ahsanoo fee haazihid dunyaa hasanah; Wa-ardul laahi waasi'ah; innamaa yuwaffas saabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisab

11.t: Say, “I am commanded to worship Allah, being sincerely devoted to Him ˹alone˺
11.tr: Qul inneee umirtu an a'budal laaha mukhlisal lahud deen

12.t: And I am commanded to be the first of those who submit ˹to His Will˺.”

13.t: Say, “I truly fear—if I were to disobey my Lord—the torment of a tremendous Day.”
13.tr: Qul inneee akhaafu in 'asaitu Rabbee 'azaaba Yawmin 'azeem

14.t: Say, “It is ˹only˺ Allah that I worship, being sincere in my devotion to Him
14.tr: Qulil laaha a'budu mukhlisal lahoo deenee

15.t: Worship then whatever ˹gods˺ you want instead of Him.” Say, “The ˹true˺ losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on Judgment Day. That is indeed the clearest loss.”
15.tr: Fa'budoo maa shi'tum min doonih; qul innal khaasireenal lazeena khasirooo anfusahum Wa-ahleehim yawmal qiyaamah; alaa zaalika huwal khusraanul mubeen

16.t: They will have layers of fire above and below them. That is what Allah warns His servants with. So fear Me, O My servants
16.tr: Lahum min fawqihim zulalum minan Naari Wa-min tahtihim zulal; zaalika yukhaw-wiful laahu bihee 'ibaadah; yaa-'ibaadi fattaqoon

17.t: And those who shun the worship of false gods, turning to Allah ˹alone˺, will have good news. So give good news to My servants ˹O Prophet˺—
17.tr: Wallazeenaj tanabut Taaghoota aien ya'budoohaa Wa-anaabooo ilal laahi lahumul bushraa; fabashshir 'ibaad

18.t: those who listen to what is said and follow the best of it. These are the ones ˹rightly˺ guided by Allah, and these are ˹truly˺ the people of reason
18.tr: Allazeena yastami'oonal qawla fayattabi'oona ahsanah; ulaaa'ikal lazeena hadaahumul laahu Wa-ulaaa'ika hum ulul albaab

19.t: What about those against whom the decree of torment has been justified? Is it you ˹O Prophet˺ who will then save those bound for the Fire
19.tr: Afaman haqqa 'alaihi kalimatul 'azaab; afa-anta tunqizu man fin Naar

20.t: But those mindful of their Lord will have ˹elevated˺ mansions, built one above the other, under which rivers flow. ˹That is˺ the promise of Allah. ˹And˺ Allah never fails in ˹His˺ promise
20.tr: Laakinil lazeenat taqaw Rabbahum lahum ghurafum min fawqihaa ghurafum mabniyyatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; wa'dal laah; laa yukhliful laahul mee'aad

21.t: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky—channelling it through streams in the earth—then produces with it crops of various colours, then they dry up and you see them wither, and then He reduces them to chaff? Surely in this is a reminder for people of reason
21.tr: Alam tara annal laaha anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fasalakahoo yanaabee'a fil ardi summa yukhriju bihee zar'am mukhtalifan alwaanuhoo summa yaheeju fatarahu musfarran summa yaj'aluhoo hutaamaa; inna fee zaalika lazikraa li-ulil albaab

22.t: Can ˹the misguided be like˺ those whose hearts Allah has opened to Islam, so they are enlightened by their Lord? So woe to those whose hearts are hardened at the remembrance of Allah! It is they who are clearly astray
22.tr: Afaman sharahal laahu sadrahoo lil-Islaami fahuwa 'alaa noorim mir Rabbih; fa-wailul lilqaasiyati quloobuhum min zikril laah; ulaaa'ika fee dalaalim mubeen

23.t: ˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ has sent down the best message—a Book of perfect consistency and repeated lessons—which causes the skin ˹and hearts˺ of those who fear their Lord to tremble, then their skin and hearts soften at the mention of ˹the mercy of˺ Allah. That is the guidance of Allah, through which He guides whoever He wills. But whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide
23.tr: Allahu nazzala ahsanal hadeesi Kitaabam mutashaa-biham masaaniya taqsha'irru minhu juloodul lazeena yakhshawna Rabbahum summa taleenu julooduhum Wa-quloo-buhum ilaa zikril laah; zaalika hudal laahi yahdee bihee maien yashaaa'; Wa-maien yudlilil laahu famaa lahoo min haad

24.t: Are those who will only have their ˹bare˺ faces to shield themselves from the awful torment on Judgment Day ˹better than those in Paradise˺? It will ˹then˺ be said to the wrongdoers: “Reap what you sowed!”
24.tr: Afamaien yattaqee biwaj-hihee sooo'al 'azaabi Yawmal Qiyaamah; Wa-qeela lizzaali-meena zooqoo maa kuntum taksiboon

25.t: Those before them ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺, then the torment came upon them from where they least expected
25.tr: Kazzabal lazeena min qablihim fa-ataahumul 'azaabu min haisu laa yash'uroon

26.t: So Allah made them taste humiliation in this worldly life, but far worse is the punishment of the Hereafter, if only they knew
26.tr: Fa-azaaqahumul laahul khizya fil hayaatid dunyaa Wa-la'azaabul Aakhirati akbar; law kaanoo ya'lamoon

27.t: We have certainly set forth every ˹kind of˺ lesson for people in this Quran, so perhaps they will be mindful
27.tr: Wa-laqad darabnaa linnaasi fee haazal Qur-aani min kulli masalil la'allahum yatazakkaroon

28.t: ˹It is˺ a Quran ˹revealed˺ in Arabic without any crookedness, so perhaps they will be conscious ˹of Allah˺

29.t: Allah sets forth the parable of a slave owned by several quarrelsome masters, and a slave owned by only one master. Are they equal in condition? Praise be to Allah! In fact, most of them do not know
29.tr: Darabal laahu masalar rajulan feehi shurakaaa'u mutashaakisoona Wa-rajulan salamal lirajulin hal yastawi-yaani masalaa; alhamdu lillaah; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoon

30.t: You ˹O Prophet˺ will certainly die, and they will die too

31.t: Then on the Day of Judgment you will ˹all settle your˺ dispute before your Lord
31.tr: Summa innakum Yawmal Qiyaamati 'inda Rabbikum takhtasimoon

32.t: Who then does more wrong than those who lie about Allah and reject the truth after it has reached them? Is Hell not a ˹fitting˺ home for the disbelievers
32.tr: Faman azlamu mimman kazaba 'alal laahi Wa-kazzaba bissidqi iz jaaa'ah; alaisa fee Jahannama maswal lilkaafireen

33.t: And the one who has brought the truth and those who embrace it—it is they who are the righteous
33.tr: Wallazee jaaa'a bissidqi Wa-saddaqa biheee ulaaa'ika humul muttaqoon

34.t: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the good-doers
34.tr: Lahum maa yashaaa'oona 'inda Rabbihim; zaalika jazaaa'ul muhsineen

35.t: As such, Allah will absolve them of ˹even˺ the worst of what they did and reward them according to the best of what they used to do
35.tr: Liyukaffiral laahu 'anhum aswa allazee 'amiloo Wa-yajziyahum ajrahum bi-ahsanil lazee kaano ya'maloon

36.t: Is Allah not sufficient for His servant? Yet they threaten you with other ˹powerless˺ gods besides Him! Whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide
36.tr: Alaisal laahu bikaafin 'abdahoo Wa-yukhawwi-foonaka billazeena min doonih; Wa-maien yudlilil laahu famaa lahoo min haad

37.t: And whoever Allah guides, none can lead astray. Is Allah not Almighty, capable of punishment
37.tr: Wa-maien yahdil laahu famaa lahoo min mudil; alai-sal laahu bi'azeezin zin tiqaam

38.t: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “Allah!” Ask ˹them˺, “Consider then whatever ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah: if it was Allah’s Will to harm me, could they undo that harm? Or if He willed ˹some˺ mercy for me, could they withhold His mercy?” Say, “Allah is sufficient for me. In Him ˹alone˺ the faithful put their trust.”
38.tr: Wa-la'in sa-altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal-arda la-yaqoolunal laah; qul afara'aitum maa tad'oona min doonil laahi in araadaniyal laahu bidurrin hal hunna kaashi-faatu durriheee aw araadanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikaatu rahmatih; qul hasbiyal laahu 'alaihi yatawakkalul mutawakkiloon

39.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O my people! Persist in your ways, for I ˹too˺ will persist in mine. You will soon come to know
39.tr: Qul yaa qawmi'maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innee 'aamilun fasawfa ta'lamoon

40.t: who will be visited by a humiliating torment ˹in this life˺ and overwhelmed by an everlasting punishment ˹in the next˺.”

41.t: Surely We have revealed to you the Book ˹O Prophet˺ with the truth for humanity. So whoever chooses to be guided, it is for their own good. And whoever chooses to stray, it is only to their own loss. You are not a keeper over them
41.tr: Innaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Kitaaba linnaasi bilhaqq; famanih tadaa falinafsihee Wa-man dalla fa-innamaa yadillu 'alaihaa Wa-maaa anta 'alaihim biwakeel

42.t: ˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ calls back the souls ˹of people˺ upon their death as well as ˹the souls˺ of the living during their sleep. Then He keeps those for whom He has ordained death, and releases the others until ˹their˺ appointed time. Surely in this are signs for people who reflect
42.tr: Allaahu yatawaffal anfusa heena mawtihaa wallatee lam tamut fee manaamihaa fa-yumsikul latee qadaa 'alaihal mawta Wa-yursilul ukhraaa ilaaa ajalim musammaa; inna fee zaalika la-Aayaatil liqawmaien yatafakkarroon

43.t: Or have they taken others besides Allah as intercessors? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “˹Would they do so,˺ even though those ˹idols˺ have neither authority nor intelligence?”
43.tr: Amit takhazoo min doonil laahi shufa'aaa'; qul awalaw kaanoo laa yamlikoona shai'aw Wa-laa ya'qiloon

44.t: Say, “All intercession belongs to Allah ˹alone˺. To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned.”
44.tr: Qul lillaahish shafaa'atu jamee'aa; lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal-ardi summa ilaihi turja'oon

45.t: Yet when Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are filled with disgust. But as soon as those ˹gods˺ other than Him are mentioned, they are filled with joy
45.tr: Wa-izaa zukiral laahu wahdahush ma-azzat quloobul lazeena laa yu'minoona bil-Aakhirati Wa-izaa zukiral lazeena min dooniheee izaa hum yastabshiroon

46.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O Allah—Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the seen and unseen! You will judge between Your servants regarding their differences.”
46.tr: Qulil laahumma faatiras samaawaati wal-ardi 'Aalimal Ghaibi washshahaadati Anta tahkumu baina 'ibaadika fee maa kaanoo feehee yakhtalifoon

47.t: Even if the wrongdoers were to possess everything in the world twice over, they would certainly offer it to ransom themselves from the horrible punishment on Judgment Day, for they will see from Allah what they had never expected
47.tr: Wa-law anna lillazeena zalamoo maa fil ardi jamee'anw Wa-mislahoo ma'ahoo laftadaw bihee min sooo'il azaabi Yawmal Qiyaamah; Wa-badaa lahum minal laahi maa lam yakkoonoo yahtasiboon

48.t: And the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds will unfold before them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule
48.tr: Wa-badaa lahum saiyiaatu maa kasaboo Wa-haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

49.t: When one is touched with hardship, they cry out to Us ˹alone˺. Then when We shower Our blessings upon them, they say, “I have been granted all this only because of ˹my˺ knowledge.” Not at all! It is ˹no more than˺ a test. But most of them do not know
49.tr: Fa-izaa massal insaana durrun da'aanaa summa izaa khawwalnaahu ni'matam minna qaala innamaaa ootee-tuhoo 'alaa 'ilm; bal hiya fitna-tunw Wa-laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

50.t: The same had already been said by those ˹destroyed˺ before them, but their ˹worldly˺ gains were of no benefit to them
50.tr: Qad qaalahal lazeena min qablihim famaaa aghnaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon

51.t: So the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds overtook them. And the wrongdoers among these ˹pagans˺ will be overtaken by the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds. And they will have no escape
51.tr: Fa-asaabahum saiyyi-aatu maa kasaboo; wallazeena zalamoo min haaa'ulaaa'i sa-yuseebuhum saiyyi-aatu maa kasaboo Wa-maa hum bimu'jizeen

52.t: Do they not know that Allah gives abundant or limited provisions to whoever He wills? Surely in this are signs for people who believe
52.tr: Awalam ya'lamooo annal laaha yabsutur rizqa limai yashaaa'u Wa-yaqdir; inna fee zaalika la-Aayaatil liqawmien yu'minoon

53.t: Say, ˹O Prophet, that Allah says,˺ “O My servants who have exceeded the limits against their souls! Do not lose hope in Allah’s mercy, for Allah certainly forgives all sins. He is indeed the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
53.tr: Qul yaa'ibaadiyal lazeena asrafoo 'alaaa anfusihim laa taqnatoo mir rahmatil laah; innal laaha yaghfiruz zunooba jamee'aa; innahoo Huwal Ghafoorur Raheem

54.t: Turn to your Lord ˹in repentance˺, and ˹fully˺ submit to Him before the punishment reaches you, ˹for˺ then you will not be helped
54.tr: Wa-aneebooo ilaa Rabbikum Wa-aslimoo lahoo min qabli ai yaatiyakumul 'azaabu summa laa tunsaroon

55.t: Follow ˹the Quran,˺ the best of what has been revealed to you from your Lord, before the punishment takes you by surprise while you are unaware
55.tr: Wattabi'ooo ahsana maaa unzila ilaikum mir Rabbikum min qabli aien yaatiyakumal 'azaabu baghtatanw Wa-antum laa tash'uroon

56.t: so that no ˹sinful˺ soul will say ˹on Judgment Day˺, ‘Woe to me for neglecting ˹my duties towards˺ Allah, while ridiculing ˹the truth˺.’
56.tr: An taqoola nafsuien yaahasrataa 'alaa maa farrattu fee jambil laahi Wa-in kuntu laminas saakhireen

57.t: Or ˹a soul will˺ say, ‘If only Allah had guided me, I would have certainly been one of the righteous.’
57.tr: Aw taqoola law annal laaha hadaanee lakuntu minal muttaqeen

58.t: Or say, upon seeing the torment, ‘If only I had a second chance, I would have been one of the good-doers.’
58.tr: Aw taqoola heena taral 'azaaba law anna lee karratan fa-akoona minal muhsineen

59.t: Not at all! My revelations had already come to you, but you rejected them, acted arrogantly, and were one of the disbelievers.”
59.tr: Balaa qad jaaa'atka aayaatee fa-kazzabta bihaa Wa-stakbarta Wa-kunta minal kaafireen

60.t: On the Day of Judgment you will see those who lied about Allah with their faces gloomy. Is Hell not a ˹fitting˺ home for the arrogant
60.tr: Wa-Yawmal Qiyaamati taral lazeena kazaboo 'alal laahi wujoohuhum muswaddah; alaisa fee Jahannama maswal lilmutakabbireen

61.t: And Allah will deliver those who were mindful ˹of Him˺ to their place of ˹ultimate˺ triumph. No evil will touch them, nor will they grieve
61.tr: Wa-yunajjil laahul lazee-nat taqaw bimafaazatihim laa yamassuhumus sooo'u Wa-laa hum yahzanoon

62.t: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the Maintainer of everything
62.tr: Allaahu khaaliqu kulli shai'inw Wa-Huwa 'alaa kulli shai'inw Wakeel

63.t: To Him belong the keys ˹of the treasuries˺ of the heavens and the earth. As for those who rejected the signs of Allah, it is they who will be the ˹true˺ losers
63.tr: Lahoo maqaaleedus sa-maawaati wal-ard; wallazeena kafaroo bi-ayaatil laahi ulaaa'ika humul khaasiroon

64.t: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Are you urging me to worship ˹anyone˺ other than Allah, O ignorant ones?”
64.tr: Qul afaghairal laahi taamurooonneee a'budu ayyuhal jaahiloon

65.t: It has already been revealed to you—and to those ˹prophets˺ before you—that if you associate others ˹with Allah˺, your deeds will certainly be void and you will truly be one of the losers
65.tr: Wa-laqad oohiya ilaika Wa-ilal lazeena min qablika la-in ashrakta la-yahbatanna 'amalu-ka Wa-latakoonanna minal khaasireen

66.t: Rather, worship Allah ˹alone˺ and be one of the grateful
66.tr: Balil laahha fa'bud Wa-kum minash shaakireen

67.t: They have not shown Allah His proper reverence—when on the Day of Judgment the ˹whole˺ earth will be in His Grip, and the heavens will be rolled up in His Right Hand. Glorified and Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺
67.tr: Wa-maa qadarul laaha haqqa qadrihee wal-ardu jamee-'an qabdatuhoo Yawmal Qiyaamati wassamaawaatu matwiyyaatum biyameenih; Subhaanahoo Wa-Ta'aalaa 'amma yushrikoon

68.t: The Trumpet will be blown and all those in the heavens and all those on the earth will fall dead, except those Allah wills ˹to spare˺. Then it will be blown again and they will rise up at once, looking on ˹in anticipation˺
68.tr: Wa-nufikha fis Soori fasa'iqa man fis samaawaati Wa-man fil ardi illaa man shaa'al lahu summa nufikha feehi ukhraa fa-izaa hum qiyaamuny yanzuroon

69.t: The earth will shine with the light of its Lord, the record ˹of deeds˺ will be laid ˹open˺, the prophets and the witnesses will be brought forward—and judgment will be passed on all with fairness. None will be wronged
69.tr: Wa-ashraqatil ardu binoori Rabbihaa Wa-wudi'al Kitaabu Wa-jeee'a bin-nabiyyeena wash-shuhadaaa'i Wa-qudiya bainahum bilhaqqi Wa-hum laa yuzlamoon

70.t: Every soul will be paid in full for its deeds, for Allah knows best what they have done
70.tr: Wa-wuffiyat kullu nafsim maa 'amilat Wa-Huwa a'lamu bimaa yaf'aloon

71.t: Those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in ˹successive˺ groups. When they arrive there, its gates will be opened and its keepers will ask them: “Did messengers not come to you from among yourselves, reciting to you the revelations of your Lord and warning you of the coming of this Day of yours?” The disbelievers will cry, “Yes ˹indeed˺! But the decree of torment has come to pass against the disbelievers.”
71.tr: Wa-seeqal lazeena kafaroo ilaa jahannama zumaraa hattaaa izaa jaaa'oohaa futihat abwaabuhaa Wa-qaala lahum khazanatuhaaa alam ya'tikum Rusulun minkum yatloona 'alaikum Aayaati Rabbikum Wa-yunziroonakum liqaaa'a Yawmikum haazaa; qaaloo balaa Wa-laakin haqqat kalimatul 'azaabi 'alal kaafireen

72.t: It will be said to them, “Enter the gates of Hell, to stay there forever.” What an evil home for the arrogant
72.tr: Qeelad khuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feeha fabi'sa maswal mutakabbireen

73.t: And those who were mindful of their Lord will be led to Paradise in ˹successive˺ groups. When they arrive at its ˹already˺ open gates, its keepers will say, “Peace be upon you! You have done well, so come in, to stay forever.”
73.tr: Wa-seeqal lazeenat taqaw Rabbahum ilal Jannati zumaraa hattaaa izaa jaaa'oohaa Wa-futihat abwaabuhaa Wa-qaala lahum khazanatuhaa salaamun 'alaikum tibtum fadkhuloohaa khaalideen

74.t: The righteous will say, “Praise be to Allah Who has fulfilled His promise to us, and made us inherit the ˹everlasting˺ land to settle in Paradise wherever we please.” How excellent is the reward of those who work ˹righteousness˺
74.tr: Wa-qaalull hamdulillaahil lazee sadaqanaa wa'dahoo Wa-awrasanal arda natabaw wa-u minal jannati haisu nashaaa'u fani'ma ajrul 'aamileen

75.t: You will see the angels all around the Throne, glorifying the praises of their Lord, for judgment will have been passed on all with fairness. And it will be said, “Praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds!”
75.tr: Wa-taral malaaa'ikata haaaffeena min hawlil 'Arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi Rabbihim Wa-qudiya bainahum bilhaqqi Wa-qeelal hamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'aalameen
